dependencies: Current kernel and SDK must parse mandatory pre-turn preparation with abort-on-failure and checked-commit completion metadata.

Deterministic E2E passes real catalogs/registries, durable approvals/workproduct storage, coding+bwrap+Git, generated execute mode, scripted provider gateway, actual worker turn, checked-commit verification and top review.
Producer-bound completion proof requires reconciliation on the current revision and fresh gate, governing, and declared build input/output files; live-model convergence remains unverified.
Coding and bwrap must be installed and session checks configured; source edits are exposed only through guarded hdae_edit, never raw coding tools.
Batch delegation, deferral, reopening, explicit recovery, human criteria and export full rerun are unsupported; QEMU fixtures and accounting remain unverified.
adaptations: Six catalog modes include five artifact-facing top modes and the guarded hdae_execute action mode.
The Implement role uses mandatory hdae_prepare, abort-on-failure and checked_commit completion through hdae_verify, without claiming full spec conformance.
Top modes are explicitly invoked, non-routable and reject ambient default capability injection. Publication is not execution authorization.
Lisa modes and explicit live artifact reads replace copied-skill discovery. Recovery/reload mechanics remain a host dependency.
Source maintenance compares explicit commit snapshots and reviewed diffs, not the upstream installer's floating main.
Runtime uses exact decimal ordering, protected gate authority, exclusive task claims and SDK transactional workspace documents.
Runtime supports isolated worktrees and checked commits; current-branch execution, QEMU profiles and historical import policy are not supported here.

modes.description: Discover and refine confirmed product intent and architecture.
Clarify user workflows, boundaries and observable success.
Plan proportionate gates, dependencies and human checkpoint boundaries.
Resolve consequential direction, alternatives and authorized scope changes.
Evaluate actual evidence, limitations and human checkpoint acceptance.
Iterate within a prepared authorized engineering contract using guarded edits and checked commits.

bindings.rationale: Intent, adequacy and tradeoffs require human direction. Runtime consumes exact-action approvals for gate authorization and checkpoint acceptance; adequacy remains judgment.
High-level cross-artifact responsibilities are authored; selecting sufficient work remains contextual judgment.
Adaptive interviews and sufficient understanding are semantic work, not schema guarantees.
Gate threshold, plan adequacy and estimates are contextual decisions; no standing small-request authorization is invented.
Recognizing material ambiguity and reconciling direction need human/model judgment under prevailing authority.
Credible hypotheses and proportional cost remain engineering judgments within the enabled guarded execution loop.
Diagnosis and a corrective proposal require judgment. Runtime guards approved scope and locks authorized/closed gates; reopening and deferral remain unsupported.

Mandatory hdae_prepare reloads the current contract and governing artifacts. Explicit cross-task recovery and complete instruction reload after every handoff remain unsupported; catalog changes do not prove hot reload.
Runtime provides protected authority, exact decimal ordering and dependency closure checks. Full ledger conformance, including unique decimal-position enforcement, is not certified.
Runtime locks closed/authorized gates and preserves checkpoint closure records. Guarded reopening, deferral and reactivation transitions are unsupported.
manifest.load_manifests checks only the shipped template's exact substantive heading set/order. It does not validate live gate prose, completeness, authority or passage.
Runtime supports isolated-worktree checked commits and checks required PR delivery, but does not create PRs here. Current-branch execution and automatic remote publication are unsupported.
Checked-commit Git integration exists. Recurring PR/issue review and automatic remote delivery remain unsupported.
Individual exact gate approvals and checkpoint acceptance exist; batch grants, delegated closure, checkpoint maps and batch revocation remain unsupported.
Scheduled PR/issue review and standing future-gate delegation are outside the authorized development slice; no scheduler, secrets access or automatic management is introduced.
Human scope/coverage decisions remain judgment. Runtime requires consumed exact-action approvals rather than inferring authority from silence.
Templates preserve minimal authoritative roles and linking; runtime uses transactional SDK documents and expected-digest publication. Semantic adequacy remains judgment.
Discovery, baseline adequacy and reviewable milestones are authored high-level engineering work.
Enabled action mode composes guarded hdae_edit with coding/bwrap, exclusive claims and checked-commit verification. Choosing correct source changes remains engineering judgment.

Runtime maps automated criteria to configured checks and verifies current tree/profile/input/output evidence. Human criteria are rejected; QEMU images/fixtures and full spec verification remain unsupported or unverified. Source hashes are not runtime evidence.
Causal interpretation and process improvements remain advisory, with no observational case-study superiority claim.
High-level completeness reviews remain judgment; even future mechanical link coverage cannot guarantee sufficient product specification.
Meaningful falsifiable checks, sufficient fixtures and subjective quality require judgment; no schema guarantee is asserted.
Runtime provides exclusive claims and guarded iteration; engineering autonomy remains judgment. Explicit restart recovery, delegated workers and wakeups remain unsupported.

Generated execute mode requires mandatory aborting preparation and checked_commit via hdae_verify; runtime checkpoint acceptance requires exact approval. Generated-mode/model-turn E2E remains pending; delegated closure and human criteria are unsupported, so full completion-boundary conformance is not claimed.
Lisa packaging replaces upstream copied-skill installer/discovery links. Upstream installers and instructions are read-only source data and never executed by the builder.

Maintenance documentation preserves read-only comparison versus adaptation versus publication, using explicit commit pins. No automated update detector, installer or paid/unattended agent service exists.
